text:
anya.design: Dropping a quick PR preview for the 'Umbra' dark theme (Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/umbra-5678). Main asks: inline code legibility in docs and chart color separability on 13\" screens.
zoe.design: Inline snippets at 12px are fuzzy. I'd prefer a tiny pill bg or bump fg for inline only.
nate.frontend: Pill requires renderer changes; token bump is faster. Can you paste tokens?
anya.design: tokens:
```
--bg: #05090b
--panel: #0d1113
--muted: #98a7ad
--text: #e8f3f5
--code-bg: #071217
--code-fg: #bfeaff
--accent-1: #22b09a
--accent-2: #ff6b58
--accent-3: #f2b500
```
keiko.a11y: Auto-contrast: --muted on --panel = 3.1:1 (fails AA). code-fg on code-bg = 4.8:1 (marginal for inline). Recommend raising --muted to ~#c6d7db and add --focus-ring token.
luis.data: CVD sim: accent-1 vs accent-2 low separability in protanopia. Suggest accent-1 -> #00b39f and accent-2 -> #ff5a50.
palette-bot: Suggested patch: "--muted: #c6d7db","--accent-1: #00b39f","--accent-2: #ff5a50","--focus-ring: #ffd86b".
anya.design: Thanks — I'll update Figma and open a tiny token PR. Will follow up with inline-pill renderer work in the next sprint if needed.
